name: Lector Priest
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Lector Priest (Origin)
Source Pathfinder #139: The Dead Road pg. 73
Your creator was a priest and magician, and your memories are filled with the smell of incense.

Prerequisites: Shabti.

Benefit: You gain Spellcraft as a class skill. Whenever you attempt a Spellcraft check, you can roll twice and take the better of the two results.
